name: AutoSnooze
postCreateCommand:
pip install --user homeassistant -r requirements_test.txt && npm ci && mkdir -p config/custom_components && { [ -f config/configuration.yaml ] || printf 'default_config:
http:
  server_host: 0.0.0.0
  server_port: 8124
' > config/configuration.yaml; } && ln -sfn /workspaces/autosnooze/custom_components/autosnooze config/custom_components/autosnooze
